subject: Commit rebalancing & seasonal uplift — renewal negotiation for Novalgo
messages:
From: Taylor Reed <taylor@novalgo.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novalgo.com
Date: 2027-04-05T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal + Q3 ramp — pricing flexibility request

Michael,

Quick note as we head into Q3 planning: our usage forecast indicates a material ramp starting July due to a new customer cohort and a product launch. Renewal for our current commitment is due June 30. Before we sign the renewal, procurement asked me to see if Redwood can provide more flexibility on pricing for the ramp months and a short-term buffer for overages while we onboard the new cohort.

High level asks:
- A deeper discount on the next tier between 500k–1M tokens/month (we're projecting to cross the 500k mark in Aug).
- One-month overage forgiveness / applied as a credit if we exceed committed tokens in July.
- Option to add a seasonal uplift tranche (+30% capacity) for Q3 only, with the uplift priced at a blended discount.
- Price lock for 12 months from the renewal date (procurement prefers stable unit economics).

I've attached a simple forecast for Q3 and the internal PO timeline (Novalgo_Q3_Forecast.xlsx).

Can we get an outline of options by EOD tomorrow? My procurement lead Alice (alice.tran@novalgo.com) is looped on timelines.

Thanks,

Taylor Reed
Head of Platform, Novalgo
---
Attachment: Novalgo_Q3_Forecast.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor@novalgo.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + Q3 ramp — pricing flexibility request

Taylor — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. I ran this by Ben (sales) and Marissa (billing/finance) and we can give you a concise set of options to move quickly.

High-level options I can outline now (we'll put numbers in a short term sheet):
1) Staged commit rebalancing: shift 20% of your current annual commit into a Q3 uplift tranche (30% capacity for 3 months) at a blended discount — lower per-token than on-demand but higher than full-year commit.
2) Overage grace: waive overage billing for a single month (July) up to the uplift tranche, and apply any additional overage as a credit against the following invoice.
3) Tiered discount ladder: increase the discount on the 500k–1M tier if we see sustained usage for two consecutive months — triggers are automatic.
4) Price-lock: we can offer a 9–12 month price lock, conditional on minimum quarterly commit cadence. I will include both 9-mo and 12-mo language in the draft.

I'll attach a short term sheet (Novalgo_Renewal_TermSheet_v1.pdf) with numeric scenarios and a recommended path that balances your need for near-term cushion with our ability to guarantee capacity.

Next steps: please review the term sheet and indicate which scenario you prefer. If you approve, I can lock this as a one-page amendment and route via DocuSign for signature. If procurement needs a PO first, let me know the PO number and timing.

Best,

Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Novalgo_Renewal_TermSheet_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Taylor Reed <taylor@novalgo.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Tran <alice.tran@novalgo.com>, procurement@novalgo.com
Date: 2027-04-06T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + Q3 ramp — pricing flexibility request

Michael — appreciate the quick turnaround and the draft term sheet.

A few points from procurement / finance after a quick pass:
- The staged commit rebalancing is promising. Can you tighten the blended uplift price by 10% versus the v1 term sheet? That would make the economics work for our CFO.
- For the overage grace: procurement insists on an explicit credit mechanism (not just a waiver). Can the waived overage be converted to a true invoice credit applied within 60 days?
- Regarding the price-lock: procurement prefers a 12-month lock. If Redwood can only go 9 months, can you add an automatic review at month 8 to consider a schedule extension at the same rate?

Procurement has a PO ready to issue pending final terms (PO #NOV-789). If we can close this by end of next week we can ensure the renewal before June 30. I'm happy to hop on a 30-min call tomorrow to align if that helps.

Thanks — looping Alice for scheduling.

Taylor
---
Attachment: Novalgo_PO_789_stub.pdf (pdf)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor@novalgo.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + Q3 ramp — pricing flexibility request

Taylor — thanks, and appreciate the PO stub. We've taken procurement's asks back to finance and can meet you in the middle.

Final (revised) offer summary — what we'll commit to in the amendment:
- Staged uplift tranche: 30% additional capacity for Q3 (July–Sept) at a blended uplift rate that is 6% better than v1 (we tightened pricing; not the full 10% but significantly improved).
- Overage credit: we will convert the one-month overage forgiveness to a formal invoice credit, redeemable within 60 days. We'll include explicit credit mechanics in the amendment.
- Price-lock: we will offer a 9-month firm price lock starting on the renewal effective date, with an automatic review at month 8 and an option for a 3-month extension at the same rate subject to exec approval. If procurement provides a signed PO (NOV-789) and finalizes DocuSign by 2027-04-14, Redwood will hold the blended uplift pricing for signature.

Attached is a redline of v1 reflecting the revised commercial terms. If that looks good, I'll generate the one-page amendment and route to your DocuSign link. Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance of the revised terms by reply.
2) We'll send the amendment via DocuSign and expect signed copy + PO NOV-789.
3) Finance will apply the agreed one-month credit during the first post-renewal invoice cycle.

We can also take the 30-min touchpoint if you want to run the numbers together — Ben and I are available tomorrow morning.

Thanks — looking forward to closing quickly.

Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Novalgo_Renewal_TermSheet_v1-redline.pdf (pdf)
